base: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent full-body dragon boss battle sprite for a high-quality Korean 2D collectible RPG. Primary request: create ONE new seal-bound abyss dragon, named NERGAON conceptually (NO written text). Mature imposing quadruped western dragon with four anatomically coherent legs, two broad folded-back wings, one long continuous tail, a horned angular head, obsidian-black and dark slate scales, antique bronze seal rings embedded around shoulders and chest, restrained luminous cyan cracks glowing from its chest and throat, pale ivory horns. Three-quarter side view facing LEFT, threatening grounded stance, entire silhouette within the canvas with generous transparent padding on every edge. Its head is forward-left and wings arch up/back to the right, feet rest on one baseline. Painted 2D anime game boss style, strong clean contours and detailed painterly materials matching dark bronze gothic seal UI, NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D render, NOT cute chibi. Distinct compact readable combat proportions with a powerful long neck and strong limbs. No humanoid, no rider, no extra creatures, no text, no symbols or UI frame, no scenery, no opaque floor, no fire covering the body, no cropped wings, no missing or duplicate limbs. Genuinely transparent RGBA background. Whole dragon unobscured, intended for later hand-drawn animation.
